note: CHG-224: per catalogue property, what decides the value the system uses and where it is changed. kind: EDITABLE / DECISION (changed in Gate Configuration), REGISTRY (Loop Registry), RETENTION (evidence retention policy), AUTOMATIC_FIXED (a rule of the method), AUTOMATIC_DERIVED (worked out per loop), NOT_APPLIED (a check the system does not perform). basis: the sentence shown, one string or variants by name; {placeholders} are filled per loop. where: completes the refusal 'cannot be changed in Gate Configuration: ...' (default per kind below). The property catalogue itself is unchanged.

editableBasis.notSet: Not set - the method's own value is used

where.REGISTRY: it is set in Loop Registry
where.RETENTION: evidence is kept by the evidence retention policy, the same for every loop; an administrator changes it
where.AUTOMATIC_FIXED: it is a fixed rule of the method
where.NOT_APPLIED: the system does not perform this check, so a value would change nothing
